title: Classroom Fit Matrix
description: CAT 531 textbook section connecting classroom fit matrix to an equity-oriented edtech evaluation matrix with gates applied above scored rows, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Build an edtech evaluation matrix that applies pass-or-fail gates (privacy, accessibility, equity) before scored criteria, and record eliminated tools rather than averaging a must-have away
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to make a classroom technology decision more defensible

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
